title: CreateUploadResponse
description: The server's answer to an upload request.

oneOf.description:
The server already holds this exact content.

Nothing is uploaded. This is what stops an operator sending the same show file twice.

media_item_id.description: The item that already holds it.

chunk_size.description: Chunk size the server prefers, in bytes.

media_item_id.description: The item the content will belong to once it is verified.

received_bytes.description:
Bytes already received, contiguous from the start.

A client resumes by sending from this offset. Contiguous rather than a set of ranges because a single offset is all a resumable PUT needs, and a range set would invite out-of-order writes that complicate verification for no operator-visible benefit.
